decks.notes: The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm your opponent with fast, aggressive red creatures and burn spells. By playing efficient creatures like Heartfire Hero and Emberheart Challenger, along with powerful burn spells like Burst Lightning and Lightning Strike, you can quickly chip away at your opponent's life total. The inclusion of cards like Kumano Faces Kakkazan and Monstrous Rage give you additional reach and the ability to close out games quickly. With a low curve and plenty of direct damage, this deck aims to win before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This Aggro-Auras deck focuses on quickly enchanting creatures with powerful auras to create strong attackers and protect them with hexproof. By utilizing cards like Ethereal Armor and All That Glitters, coupled with creatures like Gladecover Scout and Light-Paws, Emperor's Voice, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast, evasive threats. The inclusion of protection spells like Sheltered by Ghosts and Kaya's Ghostform help maintain board presence and push damage through, while also providing resiliency against removal. The deck's game plan revolves around suiting up creatures with auras to win the game through aggressive combat.

The main concept of this deck is to consistently assemble the combo of Greasefang and Parhelion II as quickly as possible, supported by cards like Cryptcaller Chariot, Monument to Endurance, and Guardian of New Benalia. The deck also includes cards like Fleeting Spirit and Seasoned Hallowblade for protection and evasion, as well as removal spells like Fatal Push to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to establish a strong board presence and overwhelm the opponent with its combo pieces and synergies.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The deck aims to apply pressure early in the game, utilizing cards like Emberheart Challenger, Heartfire Hero, and Monstrous Rage to deal damage efficiently. The inclusion of cards like Reckless Rage and Lightning Strike provide additional removal options to clear the way for your creatures to attack. The deck is designed to close out games quickly and decisively, capitalizing on the strength of red creatures and burn spells in a fast-paced aggressive strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly casting spells to fill the graveyard with Arclight Phoenixes, using cards like Opt, Consider, and Treasure Cruise to cycle through the deck. It also includes cards like Cori-Steel Cutter and Picklock Prankster to disrupt the opponent's strategy and interact with their board. The deck aims to be fast and aggressive, pressuring opponents with Arclight Phoenixes and using burn spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to control the board. The inclusion of Hall of Storm Giants and Otawara, Soaring City provides additional finishers for the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix, while utilizing low-cost spells and card draw to maintain a fast and aggressive playstyle. Cards like Consider and Opt help dig through the deck for key pieces, while Ledger Shredder and Treasure Cruise provide graveyard interaction and card advantage. The inclusion of counter spells like Spell Pierce and flexible removal like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe help to control the board and keep up pressure on the opponent. The overall strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with fast, powerful threats.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by using powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat, while also disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also utilizes strong creatures like Gifted Aetherborn and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to apply pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil adds another layer of disruption to the strategy. Overall, the deck aims to dominate the game through efficient removal, hand disruption, and powerful threats.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly deploy efficient threats onto the battlefield and overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful enchantments. Cards like Bishop of Wings and Righteous Valkyrie provide life gain synergies while Resplendent Angel and Skyclave Apparition offer powerful threats and removal options. With the help of ramp creatures like Elvish Mystic and Llanowar Elves, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent, ultimately leading to victory through aggressive beatdown tactics.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly cast spells and efficiently use instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard. It relies on cheap spells and card draw to enable the casting of multiple spells in a turn, triggering the Phoenix's ability. The deck also includes support cards like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe for removal and control, as well as options for generating card advantage through Treasure Cruise and Artist's Talent. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure on the opponent with a fast tempo and repeatable threats.

Ultimately, the key strategy is to play and reanimate Arclight Phoenix as efficiently as possible while maintaining pressure on the opponent.
